v1.34.5 (2 October 2024) |feed_title = Stickers |feed_color = Red |previous_update = [[v1.33.0]] |next_update = [[v1.35.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.34.0''' is the eighty-seventh update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 2nd of October 2024. This update was also given the name ''Stickers Update'' as it added [[Stickers]]. This update encompassed six versions, the main v1.34.0 update (released 2 October 2024) and five minor updates, v1.34.1 (released 2 October 2024), v1.34.2 (released 2 October 2024), v1.34.3 (released 2 October 2024), v1.34.4 (released 2 October 2024) and v1.34.5 (released 2 October 2024). ==Additions== ===Emotes=== *[[Poisoned]] ===Stickers=== *[[Flex (Sticker)|Flex]] *[[GG]] *[[32]] (Unreleased) *[[Clown (Sticker)|Clown]] (Unreleased) *[[Facepalm]] (Unreleased) *[[Mind Blown]] (Unreleased) *[[Money Rain]] (Unreleased) *[[Sad Scout]] (Unreleased) *[[Shocked]] (Unreleased) *[[Sigma]] (Unreleased) *[[Fart]] (Unreleased) *[[Skull]] (Unreleased) ===Miscellanous=== *[[Stickers]] *Sticker Wheel UI *[[Settings#Sticker|Sticker]] Sound Setting *Sticker Wheel Keybind ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Emote wheel UI overhauled. **No longer limits the number of emotes that can be equipped. **Equipping emotes now only changes the placement in the wheel. **Show's the player's avatar performing the emote instead of the emote icon. **Emote wheel is now smoother to use. *[[Poisoned]] changed. **Animation updated. **Price in store decreased from {{Coins|2,000}} to {{Coins|500}}. **No longer moveable. *[[Grave Digger]] health nerfed from 20,000 to 17,500. *[[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode wave structure changed. *[[Slasher]] is now obtainable through a gamepass for {{Robux|599}}. *Overhauled party UI to be more efficient. *Camera now pans up when teleporting to a match. *Emote wheel can no longer be opened by pressing ".". *Fixed party UI sometimes displaying incorrect Levels for players. *Fixed the monthly leaderboard not expiring correctly at the end of each month. :In '''v1.34.1''': *Corrected update log listing incorrect keybinds for the sticker wheel. :In '''v1.34.2''': *Fixed emote wheel causing other UI to break. :In '''v1.34.3''': *Fixed emote wheel getting stuck on page two, though it still occasionally stutters when going through pages. :In '''v1.34.4''': *Fixed emotes that were previously equipped to the wheel while it only had a limited number of slots from having the unequip button be shown instead of the equip button. :In '''v1.34.5''': *Fixed [[Campfire]] emote stealing input. *Fixed [[Poisoned]] not having any animations and being unplayable. *Fixed [[Parrot Party]] appearing in the emote wheel for players who owned it before its removal. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V1.33.0PromotionalImage.png GattlingGunThumbnail.png DJREWORKTHUMB.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} V1.33.0UpdateIcon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and things that are missing.'' ===v1.34.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|CyberCityUpdateLog.png|Stickers}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|New Stickers [BETA] 💥}} *Stickers are here!🎉 *Currently you can only use the default stickers *More stickers will be added on Halloween {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.34UpdateLog1.png|Flexing on you}} *Equipping stickers will prioritize the equipped sticker *All stickers can be used without being equipped *Press 'V' to open the sticker wheel *Equip stickers through the emotes inventory screen {{UpdateH3|Improved Emote Wheel🔥}} *Enjoy a new and improved emote wheel! *Any emote can now be used in the lobby and in-game *Emotes now show the animation and custom accessories in the wheel *Smoother and more responsive wheel *Scroll through the wheel with the mouse wheel! {{UpdateH3|Gamemode Changes}} *Easy Mode wave structure nerfs *[[Grave Digger]] health (20000 -> 17500) {{UpdateH3|[[Slasher]] Returns...}} *[[Slasher]] on sale and it will be around for one week *Try out the old [[Slasher]] before the rework comes *More [[Slasher]] skins will be coming soon! {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.34UpdateLog2.png|Before and After}} {{UpdateH3|Other Changes}} *Monthly leaderboard expires correctly at the end of the month *Party UI overhauled, visually the same but more efficient {{UpdateH3|🔥Coming Soon🔥}} *Halloween coming out on ⬜⬜⬜⬜⬜!🎃 *New Lobby *Pursuit Rework coming after Halloween *...keep an eye on our socials for more info!📢 }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.34.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
